tier1.notes: Provides `su`/`runuser`, which luggage uses to run install methods as the target user. Debian and Ubuntu ship it and Alpine provides `su` from busybox (so alpine is deliberately unmapped), but RHEL UBI minimal ships neither. Distro archives are GPG-signed by their archive keyrings (debian-archive-keyring, ubuntu-archive-keyring, redhat-release); trust is rooted in the host package manager.
